Great — thanks for confirming, Alex and Samir. Looping in our technical leads so we can get aligned on scope and a concrete evaluation plan. A few notes for the tech kickoff so everyone can come prepared:

- Goals: end-to-end integration proof-of-concept + quality baseline for the three priority flows listed in the MAP (search-ranking, chat-assist, and summarization).
- Success criteria: baseline F1/ROUGE targets and latency P95 under 250ms for the chat use-case (adjustable if your profile differs).
- Data: if an anonymized extract isn't feasible, a detailed schema + size distribution will suffice. We typically use a 10k item sample for offline evals and a 2000-item streaming subset for latency/load tests.
- Access: please let us know if we should use your dev cluster endpoints or set up private routing through your VPC (we support both).

Rishi and Priyom — can you each add one-sentence ownership notes here so Novus knows who to expect?

Action items:
1) Novus confirms kickoff slot (Alex/Samir/Priya)
2) Novus shares schema/sample or confirms constraints
3) Redwood provides evaluation playbook and measurement checklist (I attached a draft).

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Naomi

Hello all — I'm Priyom, ML engineer on the Redwood side. I'll partner with Samir on model evaluation and quality metrics. A couple of notes from the ML side:

- If you can share either a 1k anonymized sample or schema + label distribution, we can run a quick baseline to set expectations before the kickoff. CSV is fine — I referenced novus_sample_schema.csv in the attachment.
- For ranking tasks, please indicate how you measure relevance (clicks, human labels, proxy metric).
- We'll spin up a small baseline using the Redwood-verified 7B float model to produce a latency and quality delta; that should take ~48–72 hours once we have the sample.

I'll also add a short evaluation checklist to the shared MAP doc after this thread so procurement and engineering both have visibility. Looking forward to the kickoff — Tue 08/25 09:30 PT works for me.
